## Services

- [Electrical](https://whtelectrical.co.za/electrical/): Electrical repairs, installations, fault finding, DB boards, rewiring, COCs and generator connections across Gauteng. Contact WHT Electrical.
- [Fault Finding & Repairs](https://whtelectrical.co.za/electrical/fault-finding-repairs/): Power keeps tripping or an electrical fault keeps returning? WHT provides electrical fault finding and repairs throughout Gauteng.
- [Electrical COCs](https://whtelectrical.co.za/electrical/coc/): Need an electrical COC? WHT provides electrical inspections, remedial work and Certificates of Compliance across Gauteng.
- [Gate Motors & Electric Fencing](https://whtelectrical.co.za/electrical/gate-motors-electric-fencing/): Gate motor repairs, installations, electric fence repairs, extensions and COC services throughout Gauteng. Contact WHT Electrical.
- [Solar & Backup Power](https://whtelectrical.co.za/solar-backup-power/): Solar, inverter, battery backup, hybrid and off-grid systems for homes and businesses across Gauteng and nationally.
- [Plumbing](https://whtelectrical.co.za/plumbing/): Plumbing repairs, leaks, burst pipes and geyser services across Gauteng. Contact WHT for practical plumbing support.
- [Property Maintenance](https://whtelectrical.co.za/property-maintenance/): Painting, ceilings, drywall, tiling and general property maintenance across Gauteng. Residential, commercial and managed property support.
